PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Administration Staff

Job Responsibilities

• Develop and manage plans for Technical Clarification Meetings (Klarifikasi Teknis) based on the company’s requirements.
• Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure smooth scheduling and execution of Technical Clarification meetings.
• Prepare Technical Clarification Meeting Minutes and confirm the agreed outcomes with the Engineering and CM teams.
• Distribute the Technical Clarification Meeting Minutes to relevant parties, including the Procurement Admin team, to support the completion of documents required for the issuance of Work Orders (SPK) and/or Purchase Orders (PO).
• Ensure all Technical Clarification meeting documentation is properly maintained, organized, and easily traceable.
• Maintain the confidentiality of information and documents related to the Technical Clarification process.
• Perform other administrative tasks to support the company’s operational activities.

Job Qualifications

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Engineering or another relevant field.
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; experience in Procurement or Technical Procurement is an advantage.
• Good verbal and written communication skills.
• Foreign language proficiency, particularly English, is an advantage.
• Friendly, detail-oriented, and responsible personality.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Able to prepare reports in a clear, systematic, and well-organized manner according to business requirements.
• Strong coordination, administrative, and document management skills.
• Able to work independently and as part of a team, and comfortable working under tight deadlines.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Staff Administrasi Project Poultry

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Menyusun dan mengelola rencana pelaksanaan meeting klarifikasi Teknis (Klartek) sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.
• Berkoordinasi dengan departemen terkait guna mendukung kelancaran proses penjadwalan Klartek.
• Membuat Notulen Klarifikasi Teknis dan mengkonfirmasi ke Tim engineering & CM sesuai kesepakatan di Meeting Klartek.
• Mendistribusikan Notulen Klarifikasi Teknis kepada pihak terkait (Tim Procurement Admin) untuk proses kelengkapan penerbitan SPK dan/atau Purchase Order (PO).
• Memastikan seluruh dokumen Notulen Klartek tersimpan dengan baik dan mudah ditelusuri.
• Menjaga kerahasiaan informasi serta dokumen yang berkaitan dengan proses klartek.
• Melaksanakan tugas administrasi lainnya yang mendukung fungsi operasional perusahaan.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik atau jurusan lain yang relevan.
• Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar; pengalaman di bidang Procurement atau Procurement Teknik menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tulisan.
• Mampu berbahasa asing (terutama Bahasa Inggris) menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memiliki kepribadian yang supel, teliti, dan bertanggung jawab.
• Mampu mengoperasikan komputer dengan baik, khususnya Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, dan PowerPoint).
• Mampu menyusun laporan secara rapi, sistematis, dan sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.
• Memiliki kemampuan koordinasi, administrasi, dan pengelolaan dokumen yang baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim serta mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu yang ketat.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

1. Conduct wet laboratory analyses in accordance with established procedures and accurately record results in the SAP system.

2. Prepare testing activities, including reagent preparation and ensuring reagent quality compliance.

3. Operate laboratory equipment, perform method validation/verification, and investigate non-conforming analytical results.

4. Maintain inventory records of reagents and glassware, and perform routine maintenance of laboratory instruments and facilities.

5. Implement and comply with HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) and 5S standards to support a safe and efficient laboratory environment.

Qualifications:

• Minimum Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Technology, Biology, or a related field.
• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in laboratory analysis, preferably in the food, feed, pharmaceutical, or manufacturing industry.
• Strong knowledge of wet laboratory testing, analytical methods, reagent preparation, and laboratory quality systems.
• Available and willing to work in Lamongan, East Java

1. Melakukan analisa laboratorium basah sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku serta mencatat hasil analisa secara akurat ke dalam sistem SAP.

2. Mempersiapkan kegiatan pengujian, termasuk pembuatan reagen serta memastikan kualitas reagen sesuai standar yang ditetapkan.

3. Mengoperasikan peralatan laboratorium, melakukan validasi/verifikasi metode analisa, serta menginvestigasi hasil analisa yang tidak sesuai.

4. Mengelola pencatatan stok reagen dan glassware, serta melakukan perawatan rutin terhadap peralatan laboratorium dan fasilitas pendukung.

5. Menerapkan dan mematuhi standar K3 (Kesehatan dan Keselamatan Kerja) serta 5S guna mendukung lingkungan laboratorium yang aman dan efisien.

Kualifikasi :

• Minimal Sarjana (S1) Kimia, Teknik Kimia, Teknologi Pangan, Biologi, atau jurusan terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun di bidang analisa laboratorium, khususnya di industri makanan, pakan, farmasi, atau manufaktur.
• Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai pengujian wet lab, metode analisa, pembuatan reagen, dan sistem mutu laboratorium.
• Mampu mengoperasikan peralatan laboratorium serta aplikasi komputer, termasuk Microsoft Office; pengalaman menggunakan SAP menjadi nilai tambah.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di Lamongan, Jawa Timur.
